Have you ever noticed how the longing for real connection can sometimes leave us feeling misunderstood or even frustrated, especially with the person we care about most?
Searching for lasting love is such a wild experience—it’s thrilling, sure, but it can also bring up old wounds and unmet needs we didn’t even know we carried.
That’s where Harville Hendrix comes in, with his book, "Getting the Love You Want: A Guide for Couples." Together, we’ll explore how the dance between two people isn’t just about what’s happening right now, but is deeply shaped by everything we’ve gone through before—our earliest experiences, our hidden expectations, and the stories we tell ourselves about love.
As we journey through this, you’ll start to see the dynamics of partnership in a whole new light. We’ll look at ways to move from conflict to compassion, with practical tools and real insights that invite us to drop the blame game and truly listen to each other.
Imagine what it would feel like to see your partner with fresh eyes, to turn pain into growth, and to peel away those layers of misunderstanding that keep us apart. That’s the heart of what we’re about to discover—how a conscious, intentional connection can transform not just your relationship, but the way you love and are loved.
So, welcome to this journey. Let’s explore together what’s possible when we open ourselves up to a deeper, more fulfilling kind of love.
